doll.definition: A small replica of a person.
doll.exampleUsage: Nora displays a doll in her collection.

action-figure.definition: A small toy character has movable joints that let it take different poses for playing or display.
action-figure.exampleUsage: Sami puts an action figure on his shelf.

ball.definition: A rounded object used in throwing, kicking or other games.
ball.exampleUsage: The friends pass a ball in the garden.

blocks.definition: Solid toy pieces used to build structures.
blocks.exampleUsage: The group builds a small tower with blocks.

puzzle.definition: A problem or game that requires thought to solve.
puzzle.exampleUsage: Nora solves a puzzle during the break.

yo-yo.definition: A toy with two disks and a string that moves up and down.
yo-yo.exampleUsage: Sami makes the yo-yo move up and down.

kite.definition: A light frame with a covering, flown in the wind on a string.
kite.exampleUsage: The friends fly a kite in the park.

top.definition: A toy that spins on a point.
top.exampleUsage: The top spins on the table.

marbles.definition: Small hard balls, often of glass, used in games.
marbles.exampleUsage: Sami keeps his glass marbles in a bag.

chess.definition: A board game for two players who move their 16 pieces according to specific rules.
chess.exampleUsage: Nora and Sami play chess after dinner.

checkers.definition: A board game in which players move pieces diagonally and capture opposing pieces.
checkers.exampleUsage: The friends play checkers on a board.

monopoly.definition: A board game in which players buy properties and collect rent.
monopoly.exampleUsage: Nora chooses Monopoly for game night.

scrabble.definition: A board game in which words are formed from letters in patterns similar to a crossword puzzle.
scrabble.exampleUsage: Sami forms a word in Scrabble.

dominoes.definition: A game played with small rectangular tiles marked with dots.
dominoes.exampleUsage: The group plays dominoes at the table.

playing-cards.definition: A set of cards used for games.

dice.definition: Small objects, usually cubes marked with dots, thrown to choose numbers in a game.
dice.exampleUsage: Sami throws two dice for the game.

jigsaw-puzzle.definition: A puzzle made from numerous flat pieces that lock together to create a complete image or pattern.
jigsaw-puzzle.exampleUsage: The friends finish a jigsaw puzzle.

trivia.definition: A game or set of questions testing general knowledge.
trivia.exampleUsage: Nora answers a question in the trivia game.

bingo.definition: A game in which numbered balls are drawn at random and players cover the corresponding numbers on their cards.
bingo.exampleUsage: Sami joins a game of bingo.

video-game.definition: A game played through electronic controls that produce changing images on a computer, television, or other screen.
video-game.exampleUsage: Nora plays a video game after work.

console.definition: An electronic device designed for playing video games.
console.exampleUsage: Nora connects the console to a screen.

controller.definition: A handheld device with controls for operating a video game or toy.
controller.exampleUsage: Nora holds the controller while playing.

robot-toy.definition: A toy designed to look or act like a robot, sometimes with electronic movement, lights, or sounds.
robot-toy.exampleUsage: The robot toy moves across the table.

drone.definition: An aircraft without a pilot that is operated by remote control.
drone.exampleUsage: The drone is stored in its case.

remote-control-car.definition: A toy car operated from a distance using a handheld controller.
remote-control-car.exampleUsage: Sami turns the remote-control car with its controller.

handheld-game.definition: A portable electronic game or small device designed to be held while playing.
handheld-game.exampleUsage: Nora carries a handheld game in her bag.

vr-headset.definition: A head-worn display that presents a computer-generated virtual environment to the user's eyes.
vr-headset.exampleUsage: The VR headset shows a virtual room.

electronic-pet.definition: A digital or robotic toy designed to imitate some behaviors of a pet.
electronic-pet.exampleUsage: The electronic pet makes a sound when Nora presses a button.

bicycle.definition: A two-wheeled vehicle moved by pedalling.
bicycle.exampleUsage: Sami parks his bicycle beside the centre.

skateboard.definition: A board with wheels used for riding while standing.
skateboard.exampleUsage: Nora carries her skateboard to the park.

scooter.definition: A small vehicle with handlebars and a standing platform, usually pushed with one foot.
scooter.exampleUsage: Sami pushes the scooter with one foot.

roller-skates.definition: Shoes with small wheels used for skating on hard ground.
roller-skates.exampleUsage: Nora puts on roller skates before entering the skating area.

jump-rope.definition: A toy with a rope that is swung under the feet.
jump-rope.exampleUsage: Sami holds a jump rope for the exercise session.

frisbee.definition: A flat flying disc thrown between people.
frisbee.exampleUsage: The friends throw a Frisbee in the field.

trampoline.definition: A frame supporting a stretched flexible surface for bouncing.
trampoline.exampleUsage: The trampoline has a flexible bouncing surface.

sled.definition: A vehicle with runners used to travel over snow or ice.
sled.exampleUsage: The sled rests on the snow.

water-gun.definition: A toy modeled on a pistol that shoots water for play.
water-gun.exampleUsage: The group uses a bright toy water gun in a water game.

swing.definition: A seat that moves forward and backward from a frame.
swing.exampleUsage: The empty swing hangs from two chains.

teddy-bear.definition: A soft toy shaped like a bear.
teddy-bear.exampleUsage: Nora gives a teddy bear as a gift.

tablet.definition: A portable computer with a touchscreen.
tablet.exampleUsage: Sami opens a puzzle app on his tablet.
